title: Samsonite reports Q3 2026 results
summary: For July–September 2026, worldwide group net sales were USD 872.7 million, flat year over year in reported dollars and up 0.6% at constant currency. Travel-category revenue was USD 555.6 million, down 1.1% reported and 0.5% at constant currency. These are company/category revenues, not unit sales, retailer rankings or model popularity.
